summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by OR Royalties Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, submitting its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026. The exhibits include the financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications, and press releases on dividends and quarterly results. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond routine dividends), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine periodic report, analogous to a US Form 10-Q, required under the Exchange Act. No special-situation event is disclosed.
